_read_me: Korean written in code (not in lib/locales or lib/words). Each file says why: «words» = the meaning is also in lib/words/<id>.json for every other language (the file, or «via», imports it); «koreanOnly» = marks or Korea-only features. A new Korean phrase that users say or type needs its meaning in lib/words/src.json (then: node scripts/i18n.mjs auto) before it goes here. tests/words.test.ts reads this.

literals: danawa_lowest(query, must_words, min_price) — lowest price for a product in Korea. must_words = words that must be in the product name (model core); min_price = a price the real product can't be below (filters cases/accessories). e.g. {"query":"에어팟 프로 3","must_words":["에어팟프로3"],"min_price":250000}.
news(query, lang) — newest headlines for a topic (Google News). e.g. {"query":"전세사기","lang":"ko"}.

page_watch(url, must_words) — reads a public web page and returns the first line containing ALL must_words (e.g. a notice board or a product page). lib/voice/marker.ts.koreanOnly: examples of «let's stop» in the AI's voice guide, next to English, Spanish and Japanese ones — the AI understands every language (<<<voice-end>>>)
literals: - If the user wants to stop talking now — to end this voice conversation, in any language and any wording (e.g. «that's all for now», «let's stop here», «bye for now», «그만할게요», «대화 종료하겠습니다», «terminemos aquí», «じゃあ、終わりにします») — answer with one short goodbye in their language and end with <<<voice-end>>>; the app then closes voice mode by itself. Not when they want you to stop or cancel a task or a reminder, to stop reading this answer, when they talk about the feature itself, or when it's unclear — then just answer.
